title: Great Indian Peninsula, Epitome of Railway News
version: Digitized newspaper issue, selected original page image
lineage: The newspaper attributes the information to the directors’ eighth half-yearly report. The newspaper image was inspected directly.

passages.locator: 5 November 1853, vol. 11, no. 532, printed p. 1260 (scan page 24), Great Indian Peninsula
passages.note: The contemporary newspaper summary of the company directors’ eighth half-yearly report gives 17 April for opening Bombay to Tannah and reports two trains running daily thereafter. The directors’ original report was not inspected.
